methodology: Full actual production fields, concept story spines, HLNI metadata and production notes were read. No scripts were manually rewritten. Assessments use the unchanged rubric; unavailable/rejected outputs are unscored. The same assistant implemented and evaluated the change, so these scores are not an independent blinded human assessment. No recorded read-aloud was performed.
runSummary: This is one of three repeated trials of the same combined implementation. Some requests failed output or concept checks; their candidates and traces remain archived. Only complete returned scripts are scored. The three-trial cohort precedes the subsequent exact-quote review fix; the follow-up is a separate source revision.
crossChannelFinding: The returned scripts show some differentiated mechanisms and, in one Trust output, a real source-backed insight. They still leave important observations or consequences asserted rather than demonstrated. Missing channel outputs prevent a complete three-channel pass.
nextStep: Retain these results, examine the rejected concept evidence and treat the quote-grounded reviewer follow-up separately. Do not advance to staging or lower the rubric thresholds.
